title: Canonical finite evaluation transport for scalar-extended reduced inputs
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E,F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite extensions, and let $i:E\to F$ be a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra map. Write $A=\mathcal O_E$, $B=\mathcal O_F$ and use their specified uniformizers $t,v$. Fix $e\geq1$ such that $(t)B=(v^e)$ [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism with compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow Z,p:Z\to Y)$, let $S$ be an $E$ derived reduction-system calculus, and let $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\widehat A)$ [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. Let $n\geq0$. Use the strict constant-coefficient tower functors $T$ and $P_B(c)$ and the finite coefficient operations of [def-pur-strict-scalar-mate-evaluation-data]. Define $\sigma_M=\operatorname{scalarImageEvaluation}_M$ from $e_nP_B(c)T_X\mathcal R_E(M)$ to the restriction to constant $B$ coefficients of the finite $F$ image at exponent $e(n+1)$ of finite scalar extension of $M\otimes^L_{\widehat A}A/(t^{n+1})$. Its ordered factors are constant proper/open image evaluation, exact constant tensor evaluation, local reduction evaluation, finiteBalancing at $X$, and the normalized finite-image restriction comparison. Construct the latter from the sheafification of the actual quotient $B\to B/(v^m)$, identity-on-sections composition of its two scalar restrictions through the completion, and the existing proper/open restriction comparison. For any $F$ derived reduction-system calculus $S'$, also define ramifiedImageBalancing by composing image of reductionBalancing, inverse reindexImage, and inverse target supportModel [def-pur-strict-scalar-reduction-balancing, def-pur-native-constant-support-model]. All these maps are explicit composites; no finite-evaluation equality is asserted by this definition.

from.place: The finite evaluation calculation in strict compact-support scalar comparison, Step 7.

proof.text: Compose evalR and evalJ to evaluate constant proper/open image. The proper comparison is an isomorphism by evalR_isIso.

Sheafify the actual integral quotient homomorphism. Its geometric coefficient square is constant-section naturality. The constant-to-completion map followed by finite projection is its quotient leg by limit.lift_π.

The identity on module sections identifies iterated restriction with restriction along the quotient: their scalar actions are equal by the quotient-leg equation. ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp'App constructs this isomorphism; localize it with mapDerivedCategoryNatIso.

Compose this restriction identification with the existing compact-support restriction isomorphism. Compose the local reduction evaluation with the tensor evaluation and finite balancing to obtain scalarImageEvaluation. Name the independent ramified transport by composing exactly the last three iso factors of arrow.

lean.statement:
def scalarImageEvaluation {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (c : Compactification f) (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X)
    (e : ℕ) (he : PurCompactSupport.Ramification l E F i e) (hepos : 1 ≤ e) (n : ℕ) :
    reduction l E X S ⋙ T l E F i X ⋙ image l F c ⋙
        ev (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F)) Y n ≅
      pbcDerivedExtend (PurCompactSupport.projection l E (n + 1)
        (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) X) ⋙
      pbcDerivedExtend ((PurCompactSupport.finiteChange l E F i e he hepos (n + 1)
        (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)).map X) ⋙
      PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.finite l F (e * (n + 1))
        (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n))) c ⋙
      positiveRestriction l F Y (e * (n + 1))
        (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n))
